snippet.title: Silent Trench - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Silent Trench is a singleplayer horror game set in a dark facility deep in an oceanic trench. Pinging with your visor for snapshots is the only way to see, but it may also get you seen.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5333270/Silent_Trench/
Demo available now.

Follow development and join the community:
Discord: https://discord.gg/Ujr6u2r5Mj
X: https://x.com/drazildev
